instagram-carousel.md [no source label]: Acromegaly is a rare but serious endocrine disorder that silently progresses over years — often going undiagnosed until symptoms become severe.
instagram-carousel.md [no source label]: It begins with excess growth hormone, leading to abnormal tissue growth and a range of complications.
